nodes.description: Biallelic nonsense, frameshift, canonical splice, missense and exon deletion variants leave no functional membrane-bound ACE. ACE variants account for about two-thirds of families with renal tubular dysgenesis.

nodes.description: Disease-causing ACE variants leave no enzyme at the cell surface.
